definitions.coord: SafeYolo's canonical coordination channel for attributed agent and operator messages.

items.title: Structured completion notes keep attribution outside worker text
items.body: Terminal coord messages can now carry bounded editorial nominations without changing their legacy delivery state. Parsing rejects malformed trailers and joins sender and sequence provenance only from the canonical message envelope.

items.title: Factory improvements remain operator decisions
items.body: SafeYolo's coordinator can correlate verified improvement nominations, suppress one-off friction, freeze one exact proposal revision, and detect existing issue coverage. The ledger never applies a recommendation or creates work on its own.

items.theme: Operator access without moving the trust boundary
items.title: Mattermost projects coordination instead of replacing it
items.body: The Mattermost adapter projects selected messages for a mobile operator while coord remains authoritative. Inbound replies become operator messages only after exact identity, channel, thread, and replay checks.

items.title: Freeze the proposal body with its semantic revision
items.body: Independent review found that non-material metadata arriving after a proposal became ready could change its presentation without changing the semantic revision. The final ledger preserves the selected body until material evidence creates a new revision.

    updated = replace(current, first_seen=min(current.first_seen, seen_at), last_seen=max(current.last_seen, seen_at))

items.lesson: A deduplication key and the bytes selected for presentation must advance together; otherwise replay protection can still emit contradictory copy.

items.title: A SQLite safety lock worked on Linux and self-locked on macOS
items.body: SafeYolo's Mattermost adapter uses SQLite to remember what it has seen, prevent message replay, and match operator button presses to requests. Only one adapter should update that state at a time, so it also needs a process lease. Locking the database file itself survived Linux-heavy testing but interfered with SQLite's own locks on macOS; moving the lease to a sibling file fixed that failure. Acceptance on a real Mac then exposed more assumptions about descriptor paths. The operator's stated future direction is sandboxed macOS execution for ground-truth platform testing, not a capability SafeYolo ships today.

topic_updates.title: Coord and operator collaboration
topic_updates.material_change: Structured nominations, evidence-backed factory proposals, and authenticated Mattermost operator projection materially changed the coord surface.
topic_updates.summary: Coord is SafeYolo's canonical attributed channel between agents and the operator. Public summaries are derived from evidence; raw coordination text is not a publication source.
current_state: Terminal delivery messages may carry bounded optional nominations, but canonical envelope metadata supplies provenance and malformed trailers yield no trusted candidates.
Relay, SafeYolo's coordinator, verifies factory observations, suppresses one-off friction, checks existing issue coverage, and presents recommendations without applying them.
Mattermost is a projection for the configured operator. Exact user, channel, thread, and replay checks preserve coord as the authority.
